notes.title: Chaos in the Galaxy Update
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey rebel, long time no transmission![/b][/p][p]You’ve been out there, deep in galaxies, digging through ash, dodging lasers, and swinging through lava like it’s just another Tuesday. And we’ve been... recharging. After launch, things got a little rough behind the scenes, and we needed a breather. Our publisher stepped away shortly after release, and honestly, we were a bit burnt out. But some rest, determination, and an unreasonable amount of space coffee later... we’re back with our biggest update yet.[/p][h3]— NEW SECRET CHALLENGES AWAIT —[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373047/4107383f140f01d91a744acd24e3526a8f8f07a4.png"][/img][/p][p]Almost every sector now hides [b]brand-new secret challenge missions[/b].
We’re talking fresh bosses, tough platforming, dangerous traps, and even more reasons to revisit every corner of the galaxy.[/p][p][b]Find them all to unlock new achievements and prove you're the ultimate rebel operative.[/b]
It’s the most content we’ve added since launch, and we can’t wait to see who conquers them first.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373047/11eddbccfea751643c2c664878b9d6f26943ff66.png"][/img][/p][h3]— WANT LORE WITH THAT LASER BLAST? —[/h3][p]We’ve reworked the tutorial to give you a better sense of the world, the rebellion, and what you’re really fighting for.
You can activate it anytime in the character select screen, great for new players, or for anyone wanting a little more story with their space carnage.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Patch Notes (aka what’s new in the galaxy)[/h3][p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Secret challenge missions added across [i]almost every sector[/i]. Tons of new gameplay, enemies, and environments to master.[/p][/*][*][p]New achievements tied to completing secret challenges.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tutorial with improved storytelling and lore delivery. Toggle it on in character select.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]A note from the devs:[/b]
It’s been a while. After release, we hit a bit of a wall creatively. Between the stress of launch and some unexpected changes on the publishing side, we needed to take a step back. But we never stopped loving this game, or the players who kept playing it. Thank you for your patience and support. We’re excited to start updating DIG again.[/p][hr][/hr][p]We’d love to hear what you think about the new content. Join us on Discord or wherever rebels gather. And if you’re enjoying the game, a review goes a long way, it really helps us keep going.[/p][p]Now get out there. Dig deeper. Fight harder.
[b]— The DIG team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Dig & Swing Update
notes.content:
Salutations to you, weary space traveler! Your clothes look full of dirt and ash from digging earthy surfaces and venturing to volcanic planets with unlivable atmospheres, all in the name of the rebellion. We know exactly what you need, and it's our first content update bringing MORE of that!

It looks like some planets have orbited too close to their sector's suns and their surface has been completely scorched, tragically ending all life and lush greenery on them... which makes them perfect for some [b]GRAPPLE HOOK PRACTICE[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373047/d4c042bc64e38d921a389d85cd81130cf86bf20f.gif[/img]

[b]Two new missions [/b]have been added to the game, in which you will have to [b]prove your expertise with your rope and swing your way through fiery planets[/b] and reach the handsome rewards conveniently placed at their core. One false step (or swing) and you'll be toastier than Anakin Skywalker on the banks of Mustafar. Believe me, this is NOT the kind of tan you want to get.


There have also been reports from rebels across the galaxy, of [b]an increasing number of underground caverns[/b], imperial bases and secret stashes left by whoever came before us. From now, on [b]you will be more likely to stumble upon a wider variety of underground structures as you dig through planets[/b]. 


In keeping with the rebel directive of 'Finders Keepers', any loot you find underground is rightfully yours. Just be careful, traps and enemies might be secretly waiting to ambush you in these small areas. Unfortunately for them, we've also added some [b]improvements to your close range combat[/b]. You will now be able to learn a variety of skills that will affect different parameters of your melee weapons in ways that are almost excessive. Almost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373047/fd790d768ade4f07e5722fda961717c7728785e9.gif[/img]


See the full notes for the content update below with new improvements, features and adjustments:

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]
[h3]QoL features[/h3]
[list][*][b]Added VSync feature to the options menu[/b]. Enable it if you experience screen tearing during gameplay.[/list]
[h3]Improvements and new features[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Two new missions [/b]that will require you to [b]master the rope technique[/b] in order to achieve victory:
[list][*] "Floor is lava" in [b]sector 2[/b].
[*] "Cross the fire chasm" in[b] sector 3[/b].[/list]
[*] Added [b]new skills centered around melee attacks[/b]. Melee builds will have nothing to envy ranged builds now.
[list][*] Increase your [b]swing range[/b]
[*] [b]Increased knock back[/b] to send every enemy to their home planets, where they are needed
[*] [b]Hulk smash skill [/b](internal name, pending legal issues). Basically, a big, slow, destructive blow.
[/list]
[*] [b]Added new secret underground structures to procedural maps[/b]. You didn't know about secret underground structures? Now you know.
[*] You will have now an [b]increased chance of finding old and new secret areas[/b] while digging around, like caves full of swag and enemy lairs, to spice things up. 
[*] [b]Increased the quality of rewards in all sectors[/b] to make them at least uncommon for sector 1, rare for sector 2, and mythic for sector 3 with a small chance of upgrading to superior rarity for each reward.
[*]The "Evacuate the resistance base" mission (tree mission) have received an upgrade with different random sections inside the tree, [b]making it now different every time you replay it[/b].
[/list]

[h3]Minor adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Debris thrower boss no longer can crash you to death after being defeated, ouch!
[*][b]Updated sound effects for the Mace of tremors and Tremor cannon[/b]. Yes, your neighbors complained to us about the loud sounds.[/list]

How's that? We really want to know your opinions on the new content. People on our [url=https://twitter.com/RaiserGames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/RaiserGames]Discord[/url] server got to see this before anyone else, so leave us a follow there and be the first to know about our next steps. [b]And if you are enjoying the game, be sure to leave us a review[/b] letting us know about it, we really appreciate getting some love for our work.

[h3][b]Safe space travels![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
What's up space travellers and fellow Overlord opposers?

We're just briefly docking our spaceship to spread the news about our latest patch. We've gathered some of our loyal rebel's righteous feedback and jerry-rigged [b]an update that will focus on accessibility[/b]. If you want to show us your support for the game, [b]please leave a positive review[/b]. We'd much appreciate your heroic action!
Now, take a look at the improvements coming to the game.

[h3]New Quality of Life features in settings menu[/h3]
[list][*][b]Added an automatic dig/hit mode option[/b] - when enabled, keep the melee attack control pressed to dig/attack continuously, so you can wreck maximum chaos with minimum carpal tunnel.
[*][b]Added an option to Disable screen shake.[/b] You may fight alien fauna, space pirates and galactic oppressors, but not dizziness.
[*][b]Added an option to Disable bright flashes.[/b] We concluded it's a better fix than giving away sunglasses.
[*][b]Added an option to Disable controller vibration.[/b] We get it, wrecking absolute havoc across the galaxy is an intense enough experience by itself.
[*][b]Added a “Reset to default” button.[/b][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would put the game in fullscreen when window focus was lost then gained back, even without fullscreen activated in settings.
[*] Fixed a rare crash while browsing the Skills tab in the Japanese encyclopedia.
[/list]
[h3]Other changes[/h3]
Monk class is no longer unlocked by finishing the mission “Kill the crawlers”, which was never the intended behavior.

[h3]What's next in our course?[/h3]
We are fully embarked in developing the first content update for DIG - Deep In Galaxies. There's still a bit to go, but we've already started testing some cool ideas we might or might not share from time to time on our [url=https://twitter.com/RaiserGames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/RaiserGames]Discord[/url] channels, were other players of the game share their run and feedback.

As always, remember that your feedback is well received and will be put to good use. Most of these improvements come from user feedback, so we're always open to receiving any comment you might have about our game. Reviews are remarkably important to gain visibility, and help us a lot to keep improving. So, If you liked the game, please [b]consider leaving a review letting us know about it![/b]

[b]DIG FORWARD![/b]

notes.title: RELEASE BUILD PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
- We've reworked the backgrounds for the Grass, Barren, Snow and Ice biomes. Now you can enjoy better landscapes while you dig through their ecosystems.

- Fixed a bug preventing you from unlocking the Alien Sector. Apologies to all space travelers who ran out of fuel looking for it and are now drifting in space forever.

- Made adjustments to texts leading to the New Game+. Leonidas hints should be clearer now, or he will be fired.

- Your Space Encyclopedia has been updated with a new version, now including descriptions of the enemies you have defeated. Like a dating app except you've already swiped left.

- You will now get to meet more people after you get the True Ending *wink wink*.

- Action input (RB or E) is now dynamically displayed depending on the closest player’s
controller. YEAH, ok, we didn't think anything clever about this one.

- Made several adjustments to localization texts. Your Galactic Translators are operational now. Celebrate in your respective mother tongues.

- Several minor fixes and polishing to improve your game experience. The type you won't notice but makes your game experience way better. We hope!

notes.title: Update with fixes and adjustments
notes.content:
We are working on adding new content and features to DIG with every update. The Overlord's patch generator is a bit unstable yet, which means some wormholes may swallow your ongoing run. We are working on fixing this, but in the meantime, you can disable the automatic updates for this game on the Steam preferences.

Fixes in this update include:
- Added new backgrounds for the "Find the Holy Relic" mission.
- Fixed issue where treasure hunting space events didn't disappear correctly after visiting them.
- Updated super attack stat symbol in all skills icons.
- Fixed and issue where game sound played too loud on first launch.
- Fixed an issue where the game crashed after opening a money chest while holding 3 keys.
- Fixed an issue where wave counter box in arena didn't fit all languages.

notes.title: v0.9.5 "A New Name" Update is now available!
notes.content:
Hello there!

As you have seen, we have decided to change the name of the game. [b]From now on it will no longer be The Mole Men, but it will be called DIG - Deep In Galaxies[/b]. This is important because now every time you search for the game in your Steam Library, you will need to use the new name [b]DIG - Deep In Galaxies[/b].

This change will also include a new look as part of our efforts to raise awareness of this game to other gaming communities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39373047/e4d8126c24fd5bcc4b680287de60ec78c477b3e9.jpg[/img]

In addition to the new game style, [b]a new update has been released (v0.9.5)[/b]. In here, we have focused our efforts on further improving the overall gameplay experience of the game. We really hope that you like this new version and enjoy the new aspects that have changed since the last update. To recap, in this new version you will find:
[list]
[*] New encyclopedia where you will be able to consult all the unlockable content of the game and track your own progress
[*] New missions and events in the different sectors of the galaxy
[*] Redesign of Challenge Mode with optimization, balancing and new content
[*]New feature in the Battle Mode to include a dynamic to win by round victories
[*] GUI enhancements for an even better gaming experience
[*] SFX (Sound Effects) adjustments
[*] And, of course, bug fixes to keep the game incredibly smooth!
[/list]
For those of you who currently have an ongoing run from the previous version, this will be lost with the update. There’s too much new content that could not be transferred to previous runs, but all your overall game progress will remain intact.

Those who already own the game, or are very interested in testing it, can already join our [url=https://discord.gg/PTa5RgWzjt]Discord[/url]. There, you will be able to actively participate in the release process of the final version.

It is very important for us to receive your feedback after enjoying the game. That's why we invite you to join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/PTa5RgWzjt]Discord[/url], write a Steam review or contact us through our email [url=https://www.raisergames.com/contact-us/]support@raisergames.com[/url].

And if you want to support us, you can also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/DeepInGalaxies]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@raiser_games]TikTok[/url]! There you will find lots of fun content :)

Stay tuned for the latest news and be part of this galactic journey!

notes.title: Items, missions and balancing
notes.content:
We are back with a new content and bug fixes update! Here's the changelog:

[b]General[/b]

- New font to prepare for localization
- Loot when killing an enemy based of enemy power
- Better key loot chance overall
- Keys can now be found in chests
- Size increase/decrease in Giant/Dwarf sectors lowered
- More Space events
- Buying an item now makes a sound
- Wasp nests have less health
- "Perfect" success will now trigger correctly
- Explosive crates deal much higher damage on enemies
- Arcanite value lowered to 3000
- Stats Hats rarity common to uncommon, +1 to +2

[b]Content[/b]

- New world item: Locked chests of all rarities
- New item: Tremor Canon
- New item: Top Hat
- New item: Pirate Pants
- New item: Shirt of Super
- New item: Shirt of Life
- New item: Shirt of Strength
- New item: Shirt of Dexterity
- New item: Miner Helmet
- New item: Explosive Belt
- New item: Plumber shoes
- New item: Food Bag
- New item: Butcher Apron
- New item: Stealth Pants
- New item: Life Pants
- New item: Super Pants
- New item: Strength Pants
- New item: Dexterity Pants

- New mission: Mine Field
- New mission: Diamond Mine
- New mission: Volcano Ruins
- New mission: Magic Pearl
- New mission: Imperial Forge

- New space event: Dojo

[b]GUI[/b]

- Hide GUI when going into black hole
- Add missing skills icons
- Lost money is now displayed in red above players
- Stat increase is now displayed above players
- Loading wheel while waiting for leaderboard scores

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

- Quitting just after killing a boss won't crash the game on load anymore
- Golem don't see invisible players anymore
- Carnivorous plants won't attack a random player in multiplayer mode
- Crawlers won't randomly hit player while grounded
- Space event map markers now correctly removed after completing the event

We want to give a special thanks to Herr Keks and TIME BLIND for helping us with bug hunting and suggestions!
Thank you also to everyone giving us feedback through Steam or Discord, the game wouldn't be what it is without your help!

notes.title: Space Exploration Update
notes.content:
The game has been updated! On the agenda is a ton of new content. New missions, new weapons, equipment and skills and lots of bug fixes!

The new space navigation system offers a more diverse and clearer experience. You will now have to finish a sector before moving on to the next one. It also allows us to drastically speed up the development of new missions, which will allow us to create many more!

Here is the non-exhaustive update note:

[b]What's new[/b]:
[list]
[*]Space navigation system
[*]A ton of missions
[*]Weapons, equipment, skills
[*]Tanks
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]:
[list]
[*]Mines easier to see
[*]Explosive crates now visibly explosive
[*]Eye boss nerfed
[*]Lever boss nerfed
[*]Less traps at the beginning of the game
[*]The skill "Regenerator" is now uncommon
[*]The piloting of the ship is easier
[/list]

We continue to improve the game every day thanks to all the players who helped us balance the game and find bugs!
Don't forget to join the Discord if you have any comments for us: https://discord.gg/8veJGU33vF
